# Technical Skills 
- **Programming Languages**: Python, R, Julia, SQL, Bash, JavaScript
- **Bioinformatics**: Bulk RNA-Seq (Salmon, DESeq2), Single-Cell (Seurat, Scanpy, CellChat, NicheNet, scvi-tools, rapids-singlecell), Spatial Transcriptomics (Squidpy), Multi-omics (Muon)
- **Workflow Management & Reproducibility**: Nextflow (DSL2), nf-core, Docker, Singularity, Git, GitHub
- **ML/DL in Biology**: GNN, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, RDkit, DeepChem
- **HPC & Cluster Computing**: SLURM (sbatch, sarray), Nextflow DSL2 with SLURM executor for scalable reusable pipelines
- **Cloud**: AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage for large genomic datasets

# Research Statement 
Deciphering how spatial architecture within the tumor microenvironment drives therapeutic resistance by integrating single-cell multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, and graph neural networks (GNNs).

# Teaching Interests
- **Bioinformatics**: scalable, reproducible computational pipelines for single-cell, spatial, and bulk transcriptomics to elucidate complex disease biology.
- **Life Sciences AI**: Applying deep learning and foundation models to single-cell genomics data for high-accuracy predictive modeling.
- **Agentic AI in Biology**: Autonomous AI agents for hypothesis generation, multi-step workflow orchestration, and automated bioinformatics analysis.

# Professional Experience

```{r}
#| results: asis
get_cv_sheet('leadership') %>%
  fill(start_date, end_date, role, institution, where) %>%
  mutate(
    end_date = as.character(end_date),
    date = paste0(
      format(start_date, "%b %Y"), " -- ",
      sapply(end_date, function(x) {
        if (is.na(x) || x == "Present") return("Present")
        x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
        if (!is.na(x_num)) {
          d <- as.Date(as.POSIXct(x_num, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"))
          return(format(d, "%b %Y"))
        }
        tryCatch(format(as.Date(x), "%b %Y"), error = function(e) x)
      }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    )
  ) %>%
  make_cv_entries(date, role, institution, where, details)
```

# Publications 
\underline{Underline} indicates mentee; *corresponding 

## Journal Articles
```{r}
pubs <- get_cv_sheet('pubs') %>%
  mutate(
    journal  = ifelse(is.na(journal), '', paste0('_', fmt_venue(journal), '_.')),
    number   = ifelse(is.na(number), '', paste0(number, '.')),
    # No DOI (preprints, working papers): link the GitHub repo instead
    doi      = clean_doi(doi),
    doi      = case_when(
               !is.na(doi) ~ paste0('DOI: [', doi, '](', 'https://doi.org/', doi, ')'),
               !is.na(url_repo) ~ paste0('GitHub: [', str_remove(url_repo, '^https?://'), '](', url_repo, ')'),
               TRUE ~ ''),
    year     = paste0("(", year, ")"),
    title    = enquote(title),
    citation = str_squish(paste(author, year, title, journal, number, doi)),
    citation = str_replace_all(citation, "\\s+,", ",")
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(year))
```

```{r}
make_ordered_list_filtered(pubs, "peer_reviewed")
```

# Media Coverage
<!-- Set spacing in between list -->
\apptocmd{\tightlist}{\setlength{\itemsep}{2pt}}{}{}

```{r}
media <- get_cv_sheet('media') %>%
  arrange(desc(date)) %>%
  mutate(
      date = format(date, format = "%b %d, %Y"),
      outlet = paste0("**", outlet, "**"),
      citation = paste0(date, ", ", outlet, ": ", post, '.')
  )

media_counts <- media %>%
  count(type) %>% 
  mutate(
    type = str_replace_all(type, '_', ' '),
    type = str_to_title(type), 
    type = ifelse(type == 'Tv', 'TV', type), 
    type = ifelse(type == 'Government', 'Federal Government', type), 
    cite = paste0(type, ' (', n, ')'),
    has_press = str_detect(type, 'Press')
  ) %>%
  arrange(!has_press) %>%
  pull(cite) %>%
  paste(collapse = ', ')
```
